Stable parent and per-leg monthly keys; exact replay reads existing attempt state and never sends again.
Same key with different payload/policy is a conflict, never a new attempt.
Generation exact bytes are pinned before reserve; checker exact bytes fit its pre-reserved immutable envelope.

Monthly record failure or final chat commit failure never grants retry dispatch or a false success.

Provider spend settlement and user-response publication are distinct states.
